steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. As far as the two pages show, the offers are the same.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Box contents | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The specs are also identical on both pages. That includes the graphite colour, the 40-hour battery and Bluetooth 5.3.

The rating and review count are identical too. That may mean the reviews are for the product as a whole and not for each seller, so they don't tell you which seller is more reliable.

Because nothing separates them, I can't give you a real reason to pick one. These are the things I'd check before you pay:
- **Total at checkout:** look for tax or fees that only show up in the cart.
- **Seller reputation:** look up each seller's own ratings elsewhere, such as on the marketplace or in independent reviews. Neither page has that information.
- **Payment and return options:** see whether one checkout offers a payment method or return label that the other doesn't.

If those turn up no difference, choose either one or just go with the seller you trust more.
